reason: My customers call me, I don't type. UPI QR and my diary already work, and this sounds like one more thing to learn and check every day.
objection: How does a phone call become a card on WhatsApp? I don't believe it will pick up my calls properly, and if it gets one order or one udhaar entry wrong I have to double-check everything anyway, so I save no time.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work on my own phone for a week with my real calls and my regular customers, with no typing from me and my paper diary still kept alongside.
